reply.emotion: relaxed and comfortable after eating a good meal, warm and satisfied
notes: Do not confuse живот (stomach, belly) with жизнь (life), which sounds somewhat similar in its inflected forms.
When used to mean the physical organ or region of the body, the stress remains on the second syllable for all plural cases.

senses.definition: The front part of the body below the chest, where the stomach and other organs are located.

examples.text: У меня болит живот после обеда.
examples.emotion: uncomfortable and slightly complaining, holding the stomach

senses.definition: The internal area where food goes and is digested.

examples.text: После вкусного супа в животе стало тепло.
examples.translation: After the tasty soup, it became warm in my stomach.
examples.emotion: content and cozy, resting after a warm meal
